description: Returns the lowest current price for a PC game across the digital stores Divux tracks (Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, Humble, Fanatical, Green Man Gaming and more), each store's price and discount, and the lowest price ever seen with its date. The input is the game's title. Prices are in US dollars. PC only. Links may be paid links; the order is by price only. Applies to questions about the current or lowest price of a PC game.
name: game_deals
title: Game deals: the lowest price for a PC game
